Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full appointment-scheduler payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Book a visit","provider":{"name":"Dr. Maya Chen","specialty":"Primary Care · Internal Medicine","initials":"MC"},"location":{"name":"Downtown Health Center","address":"500 Market St, Suite 300"},"days":[{"date":"2026-08-14","slots":[{"id":"s1","time":"09:00","visitType":"in-person"},{"id":"s2","time":"10:30","visitType":"video"},{"id":"s3","time":"13:15","visitType":"phone"}]},{"date":"2026-08-15","slots":[{"id":"s4","time":"09:30","visitType":"video"},{"id":"s5","time":"15:00","visitType":"in-person"}]}],"submitText":"Confirm appointment"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): the heading shown at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Book a visit'. - 'provider' (object, optional but strongly recommended): the clinician the visit is with. 'name' (string) e.g. 'Dr. Maya Chen'; 'specialty' (string, optional) e.g. 'Primary Care'; 'initials' (string, optional, 1-2 letters) shown in the avatar when there is no photo — derived from the name if omitted; 'imageUrl' (string, optional) same-origin photo URL (e.g. a Salesforce static resource '/resource/<Name>'). - 'location' (object, optional): where the visit takes place. 'name' (string) and 'address' (string, optional). - 'days' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): the bookable days. Each day MUST have 'date' (string, ISO 'yyyy-mm-dd') and 'slots' (array, at least one). Each slot MUST have 'id' (string, unique across the whole payload, sent back on selection) and 'time' (string, 24-hour 'HH:MM' e.g. '09:00','14:30' — rendered as '9:00 AM'). Optional per slot: 'visitType' (string; one of 'in-person','video','phone'; drives the slot icon; defaults to 'in-person'). - 'submitText' (string, optional): the confirm-button label; defaults to 'Confirm appointment'. Never emit zero days or a day with zero slots. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
